categories.main_business_segments: Guangdong Jiayuan Technology Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, production, and sales of high-performance electrolytic copper foil, including lithium battery copper foil and PCB copper foil. The company also extends into new energy sectors such as photovoltaic power generation, energy storage, and high-precision copper wire manufacturing. It operates multiple subsidiaries focusing on copper foil production, new materials, and energy-related technologies.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced electrolytic copper foil manufacturing technologies including ultra-thin and extremely thin copper foil production, additive technology, cathode roller grinding, copper dissolution, copper powder cleaning, precision slitting, wastewater treatment, and copper foil inspection technologies. It has developed proprietary additive technologies and holds numerous patents related to copper foil production processes. The production emphasizes high precision, automation, and environmental compliance.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Jiayuan Technology serves primarily lithium-ion battery manufacturers, especially those in the new energy vehicle and energy storage sectors. Key customers include leading domestic battery companies such as CATL and other major players in the electronics industry requiring copper foil for printed circuit boards. The end markets include new energy vehicles, energy storage systems, 3C digital products, and electronic circuit manufacturing.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with production bases in Guangdong (Meizhou), Fujian (Ningde), Jiangxi (Ganzhou), Shandong (Liaocheng), and Shenzhen. It also actively expands its overseas market presence. The headquarters and main registered address are in Meizhou, Guangdong Province.
categories.supply_chain_position: Jiayuan Technology operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on the production of electrolytic copper foil, a key raw material for downstream lithium-ion battery and PCB manufacturers. It also integrates upstream supply of copper wire and downstream sales and technical services, with some vertical integration into related new energy sectors.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in ultra-thin and high-strength lithium battery copper foil, micro-porous copper foil, composite copper foil, and high-performance electronic circuit copper foil. It invests heavily in R&D, collaborates with universities and research institutes, and focuses on product differentiation through technology leadership. Strategic initiatives include digital transformation, green energy development, and expanding into photovoltaic and energy storage markets.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of high-performance electrolytic copper foil products to lithium-ion battery manufacturers and PCB producers. The company also earns income from sales of copper wire, photovoltaic engineering contracting, and trading of precious metals like gold. Pricing is generally based on a 'copper price plus processing fee' model.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Jiayuan Technology is positioned as a leading domestic manufacturer in the high-performance lithium battery copper foil industry, ranking among the top in production capacity and technology. It competes with other domestic and international copper foil producers, facing intensified competition due to industry expansion and new entrants. The company emphasizes technological innovation and strategic partnerships to maintain its competitive edge.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 4.97 billion, a 7.06% increase from the previous year, with a net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 19 million, reflecting a significant profit decline due to market pressures. Total assets reached RMB 12.8 billion, growing 18.58% year-over-year. The company has expanded production capacity to 100,000 tons annually and continues to invest in capacity and technology upgrades.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Jiayuan Technology offers a broad range of high-performance copper foil products with superior physical and chemical properties, including ultra-thin, high-strength, and micro-porous copper foils tailored for advanced lithium-ion batteries and high-end electronic circuits. Its proprietary additive technologies and precision manufacturing processes enable enhanced battery energy density, safety, and performance. The company also emphasizes environmental sustainability and digital transformation to deliver reliable, high-quality products and services.
